traceability.evidence: Core maintenance API implemented in src/maintenance/: detectStaleAnnotations (detect.ts), updateAnnotationReferences (update.ts), batchUpdateAnnotations & verifyAnnotations (batch.ts), generateMaintenanceReport (report.ts), and CLI entry/dispatch in cli.ts and commands.ts. All are annotated with @story docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md and the corresponding REQ-MAINT-* IDs.,API export integration: src/maintenance/index.ts re‑exports detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations, generateMaintenanceReport; src/index.ts attaches them to the plugin as `maintenance` and exports them, satisfying REQ-MAINTENANCE-API-EXPORT and the ‘Integration’ acceptance criterion.,Core behavior tests for each requirement:,- REQ-MAINT-DETECT: tests/maintenance/detect.test.ts verifies empty result when no stale annotations and detection of a stale story path; tests/perf/maintenance-large-workspace.test.ts '[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detectStaleAnnotations completes within a generous time budget'; tests/perf/maintenance-cli-large-workspace.test.ts '[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detect --json completes within a generous time budget and returns JSON payload'; tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts multiple '[REQ-MAINT-DETECT]' cases including JSON output and non-existent --root handling.,- REQ-MAINT-UPDATE: src/maintenance/update.ts implements in-place `@story oldPath` → `@story newPath` replacement with regex; tests/maintenance/update.test.ts and tests/maintenance/update-isolated.test.ts verify correct update, 0 updates when nothing to change or directory missing, and that files are modified as expected; tests/perf/maintenance-large-workspace.test.ts validates performance and non-trivial update counts.,- REQ-MAINT-BATCH: src/maintenance/batch.ts batchUpdateAnnotations loops over mappings and calls updateAnnotationReferences; tests/maintenance/batch.test.ts '[REQ-MAINT-BATCH] should return 0 when no mappings applied'; tests/perf/maintenance-large-workspace.test.ts '[REQ-MAINT-UPDATE] updateAnnotationReferences and batchUpdateAnnotations remain tractable' with multiple mappings.,- REQ-MAINT-VERIFY: verifyAnnotations in batch.ts wraps detectStaleAnnotations; tests/maintenance/batch.test.ts '[REQ-MAINT-VERIFY] should return true when annotations are valid'; tests/perf/maintenance-large-workspace.test.ts '[REQ-MAINT-VERIFY] verifyAnnotations remains fast on large workspaces' and returns false when there are stale refs; tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts two '[REQ-MAINT-VERIFY]' cases verify exit codes 0/1 and user guidance.,- REQ-MAINT-REPORT: generateMaintenanceReport in report.ts returns "" on no stale, or newline-separated stale paths; tests/maintenance/report.test.ts cover empty and non-empty reports; tests/perf/maintenance-large-workspace.test.ts '[REQ-MAINT-REPORT] generateMaintenanceReport produces output within a generous time budget'; CLI-level behavior for text and JSON reports is covered in tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts and tests/perf/maintenance-cli-large-workspace.test.ts.,- REQ-MAINT-SAFE: Safety and error handling are implemented and tested: detectStaleAnnotations returns [] for non-existent or non-directory roots and swallows read errors (detect.ts, getInProjectCandidates, anyInProjectCandidateExists); CLI runMaintenanceCli in src/maintenance/cli.ts wraps dispatch in try/catch and prints 'traceability-maint failed: ...' on unexpected errors; commands.ts uses explicit exit codes EXIT_OK, EXIT_STALE, EXIT_USAGE, validates required flags for update, and supports dry-run mode. tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts covers: missing --from/--to returns exit 2 and logs error; dry-run performs no file changes and exits 0; invalid --format causes exit 2 and clear error; detect with non-existent --root exits 0 and prints 'No stale @story annotations found.'; permission errors on statSync cause detect to exit 2 with a prefixed error message; help and no subcommand behavior are also validated.,Acceptance criteria mapping:,- Core Functionality (detect & update when stories moved/renamed): detectStaleAnnotations finds @story paths whose targets no longer exist; updateAnnotationReferences and batchUpdateAnnotations perform replacements across the workspace. This end‑to‑end path is exercised in detect/update/batch tests and large‑workspace perf tests.,- Quality Standards (preserve code/formatting): updateAnnotationReferences only replaces the story path substring after '@story', and writes files only when content changes (update.ts). Tests (update-isolated.test.ts, update.test.ts) confirm the annotation path is updated while the rest of the content remains intact; other tools (detect, verify, report) are read‑only.,- Integration: Maintenance functions are exported via src/maintenance/index.ts and wired into src/index.ts as `maintenance`, with tests in tests/maintenance/index.test.ts ensuring all functions are exported as functions. The CLI is wired via the bin entry in package.json ('traceability-maint': 'lib/src/maintenance/cli.js') and exercised by multiple Jest integration tests.,- User Experience: commands.ts implements clear, human-readable messages and JSON payloads; tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts and tests/perf/maintenance-cli-large-workspace.test.ts assert specific output strings and JSON shapes for detect, verify, report, update, and dry-run modes, satisfying the 'clear feedback about what was changed' criterion.,- Error Handling: detectStaleAnnotations handles non-existent roots, read errors, and project-boundary issues without throwing; the CLI maps configuration and permission issues to exit code 2 with descriptive messages (verified in cli.test.ts). Edge cases like invalid --format and missing flags are explicitly tested.,- Documentation: README.md 'Maintenance CLI' section documents traceability-maint commands with concrete examples; user-docs/api-reference.md has a dedicated 'Maintenance API and CLI' section (lines ~417–720) documenting all five maintenance functions and the CLI commands, including behavior notes, exit codes, JSON formats, dry‑run semantics, and example invocations.,Test run: `npm test -- --runInBand --verbose` (captured earlier) shows all maintenance-related test suites passing: tests/maintenance/*.test.ts, tests/perf/maintenance-large-workspace.test.ts, tests/perf/maintenance-cli-large-workspace.test.ts, and tests/maintenance/index.test.ts, with no failures.
traceability.notes: docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md defines maintenance helpers and CLI for detecting, updating, batching, verifying, and reporting on stale @story annotations, with safety and good UX. The implementation provides a full maintenance API (detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations, generateMaintenanceReport), wires it into the ESLint plugin export, and exposes a dedicated CLI (traceability-maint) with detect/verify/report/update subcommands. Comprehensive unit, integration, CLI, and performance tests directly reference this story and its REQ-MAINT-* requirements, and all pass. User and developer documentation cover the API and CLI usage with examples. All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are satisfied.
